literal_meaning: ছাঁচের সাথে মেলে না এমন, অসমানুপাতিক
figurative_meaning_bn: কদাকার, ছাঁচের সাথে মেলে না এমন
figurative_meaning_en: Ill-proportioned, awkward, not fitting the standard mold
similar_in_english: Square peg in a round hole
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই পোশাকটা তার উপর বেঢপ বসেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: This outfit doesn't fit him well; it looks awkward.
note: Refers to something mismatched or disproportionate, often used in everyday Bengali speech to describe ungainly looks.
